test_muon_reshape_inverse: test the _compute_muon_reshape function to reshape and inverse reshape tensors with various dimension configurations
test_muon_orthogonalization_modes: test the muon optimizer with frobenius, aol, and schatten preconditioning modes on square, tall, and wide matrices
test_muon_orthogonality: test that muon optimizer updates satisfy approximate orthogonality constraint U^T U approx I
test_muon_complex_mixed_target: test the muon optimizer on complex mixed tensor optimization targets with adaptive and nesterov options
test_muon_orthogonalize_via_newton_schul: test the orthogonalize_via_newton_schulz function to produce orthonormal real and unitary complex matrices
